name: Tatsumi
source:
He fell in love with V-Boarding when [url=/c48740]Gengai[/url] from the Great Fang Militia and now he trains on his own, travelling to many places.
He has known [url=/c39367]Aoto[/url] for a month now. When he decided to help Aoto and [url=/c39368]Saki[/url], his fate took a dramatic turn.
